credits.title: Hungry Ghost Festival
credits.overview: After inadvertently violating a sacred ancestral taboo during the Hungry Ghost Festival, an adopted young man and his friends must break a relentless supernatural curse before the spiritual gates close permanently.

credits.title: The Sea Speaks His Name
credits.overview: Set during the volatile final months of Indonesia’s New Order regime, the narrative chronicles a young student activist's perilous commitment to pro-democracy underground movements and his family's subsequent, grueling quest for justice following his forced disappearance.

credits.title: Gudang Merica
credits.overview: A medical student’s routine hospital rotations take a terrifying turn when an unidentified patient dies under their care, triggering supernatural encounters and the mysterious disappearance of the body that forces them to confront a disturbing hidden truth.

credits.title: Sambung Silaturahmi
credits.overview: A comedy drama about human characters who are often selfish and prioritize their own interests, yet sometimes forget to empathize and open their hearts to reconnect and build meaningful relationships with the people around them.

credits.title: Risky Business 2
credits.overview: When three estranged brothers discover their missing fortune was secretly used to reclaim their seized family home, a hidden photo found inside a torn suitcase plunges them into a deadly web involving a dangerous businessman, a corrupt prosecutor, and the darkest secrets of their own past.

credits.title: Dopamine
credits.overview: A young couple facing eviction and debt experiences an unexpected event that changes their lives.

credits.title: Gerbang Setan
credits.overview: Diki, Beni, Rachel, Bagas, and Wina went on a horror trip to Lawase Urip Village after Beni found a mysterious flyer on the campus bulletin board.
